entities.summary: Michel, Baron D'Hooghe is a Belgian former member of the FIFA Council and the former chairman of the FIFA medical committee. D'Hooghe, a medical doctor, was President of the Royal Belgian Football Association (1987-2001) and President of Club Brugge KV (2003-2009). In 2001, he was ennobled as a baron.
